document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You wake up on the morning of the second day of the trip, and 
there’s no one in sight. You have been completely abandoned by 
your guide. You breath a sigh of relief, though, as before he drove 
off in the car, he thoughtfully unloaded any gear belonging to you. 
Decide what you can carry; maybe you can pick up the rest later. 
To reach safety you either can swim the Nile in high flood, 
or you can follow the car tracks back to that little village not 
too far away. To go swimming, go to 588; for village, go to 589.
(108)
